subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment qualification — hardware / upgrades / offline ops
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@legacybank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment qualification — hardware / upgrades / offline ops

Tom — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap + next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of what we heard (from your team):
- Primary requirement: on-prem Private deployment in an air-gapped environment (no outbound internet).
- Target workloads: real-time document indexing + chat layer for internal compliance tooling, ~200 QPS peak, 30k tokens/sec sustained burst capacity during batch jobs.
- SLOs: 95th percentile p95 latency <= 300ms for typical chat generation, and nightly batch embedding runs (non-latency sensitive).
- Security: HSM/KMS for key management, SOC2 evidence required, quarterly audits.
- Upgrade policy: offline image-based upgrades preferred; minimal downtime windows (aim <2 hours), and manual approval for major DB/KV changes.

Open technical items we need to confirm:
1) Hardware footprint: do you prefer Redwood to provide an approved BOM for procurement vs. you sourcing hardware? If you want us to propose, we can send a recommended 3-tier BOM (min/recommended/high-availability).
2) On upgrades: do you require physical media (USB/airgap registry via import), or is an internal mirror registry acceptable (we provide signed images that your infra team pulls from an internal registry)?
3) Network / firewall: which outbound hosts (if any) can be whitelisted during install? Are there constrained VLANs for management?
4) Maintenance ops: who will be the day-to-day operator (LB infra team vs. a dedicated Redwood on-call)?

Attachments: I attached our on-prem requirements doc and a starter BOM and network diagram.

Proposed next steps:
- Marcus / Dev and I to share a recommended BOM and an offline upgrade playbook by EOD tomorrow (3/29).
- LegacyBank to confirm preferred procurement path and whether they can host an internal registry or need image import.
- Schedule a 90-minute technical workshop (Marcus + Dev + LB infra) next week to walk through the upgrade flow and runbook.

If that all looks good, please reply with answers to 1-4 and any additional constraints. Thanks — appreciate the time today.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Tom Harris <tharris@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@legacybank.com>, LegacyBank IT <it-infra@legacybank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment qualification — hardware / upgrades / offline ops

Thanks Marissa — this is great. Quick answers inline below.

On your open items:
1) Procurement: We prefer to procure through our central purchasing (LegacyBank Purchasing). Please send an approved BOM that passes our internal compliance review — we will handle buying.
2) Upgrades: We cannot accept outbound connections to 3rd party registries. Internal mirror registry is acceptable if we can verify signed images (we run periodic vulnerability scans). If not possible, image import (signed USB or S3 transfer via controlled circuitry) is OK.
3) Network: No outbound whitelisting to public hosts is allowed. Management VLAN exists that can reach an internal registry and an internal NTP server. We'll share a network zone map during the workshop.
4) Maintenance ops: LB infra will be primary operators. We will want Redwood on-call for first 90 days post-go-live for escalation and help with major upgrades.

Other notes:
- HSM/KMS: we have an on-prem HSM available; we will want Redwood to integrate with our HSM via PKCS#11 or KMIP.
- Audit logs: we will need detailed access logs (who invoked inference, token counts, model version) retained for 2 years.

Happy to take the workshop next Tue/Wed afternoon — Priya and our infra lead will coordinate availability.

—Tom
Tom Harris
Head of Platform Engineering | LegacyBank
tharris@legacybank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@legacybank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@legacybank.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment qualification — hardware / upgrades / offline ops

Tom / Priya — perfect, thanks for the clarifications — that helps a lot. Quick confirmation and what we'll deliver tomorrow: 

Confirmations from our side:
- We will produce an "Approved BOM" document (min / recommended / HA) that your purchasing team can use. It will include SKU-level guidance and network I/O expectations.
- For upgrades we will support both flows: (A) signed images you import into your internal registry (we'll provide signature verification steps and signed manifests) and (B) manual image import via secure media with checksums. We'll include cryptographic verification steps and an audit checklist.
- Integration with PKCS#11 / KMIP: Marcus will own the HSM integration design and will bring a short spec to the workshop.
- Audit logging: Redwood can export token-level logs to your internal ELK/Splunk via secure syslog/file ingestion. We'll include retention and encryption details in the runbook.

Deliverables (by EOD 3/29):
- redwood_onprem_requirements_v2.pdf (attached) — detailed install and security constraints.
- legacybank_proposed_bom.xlsx (attached) — SKU + capacity planning.
- network_diagram_v1.png (attached) — draft mapping of management vs. data planes.
- offline_upgrade_playbook.md (link included) — steps for image import and verification.

Workshop: Marcus, Dev and I are available Tue 3/30 1-3pm PT or Wed 3/31 10am-12pm PT. Which works best for you?

Next actions for LegacyBank: 
- Confirm which procurement path (you indicated central purchasing — we will flag any long-lead items).
- Share internal registry details or the import process your team prefers.

Thanks — we'll see you at the workshop.

—
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Prep for LB workshop / BOM + HSM spec

Internal quick note — tagging tasks before we send final docs to LegacyBank:
- Marcus: finalize HSM integration spec (KMIP + PKCS#11 code snippets) — deliver: 3/29 EOD.
- Dev: validate that our image signing tooling produces a checksum + signature bundle that works with LB offline import flow; capture sample import commands.
- Marissa: include procurement notes about lead times and any recommended reserved capacity (Redwood Dedicated vs Private).

I'll assemble a one-pager runbook for the workshop and QA steps for image verification. Attach final artifacts to the doc we send.

—Marcus
